limitations: A larger grant can strand up to 255 unused attempts after one upload, or all 256 after a lost grant acknowledgement; no credit is restored or refunded.
Closed-loop short run; random database placement and provider conditions differ from previous releases.
Prepared journal counters include setup/catalog work and frames whose uploads fail, not successful PUTs or provider billing.
No sustained-load, open-loop arrival-rate, p99, or availability SLO qualification.
Existing single-trust-domain 1.0 support scope is unchanged.
